queries.tables: SELECT table_schema,table_name,table_type FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' ORDER BY table_name
queries.columns: SELECT table_name,column_name,ordinal_position,data_type,udt_name,is_nullable,column_default,character_maximum_length,numeric_precision,numeric_scale,is_identity,identity_generation,generation_expression FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position
queries.constraints:
SELECT c.conname AS name,t.relname AS table_name,c.contype AS kind,c.condeferrable AS deferrable,c.condeferred AS initially_deferred,c.convalidated AS validated,pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid,true) AS definition,
ARRAY(SELECT a.attname FROM unnest(c.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY k(num,n) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.conrelid AND a.attnum=k.num ORDER BY k.n) AS columns,
CASE WHEN c.contype='f' THEN rt.relname END AS referenced_table,
CASE WHEN c.contype='f' THEN rn.nspname END AS referenced_schema,
ARRAY(SELECT a.attname FROM unnest(c.confkey) WITH ORDINALITY k(num,n) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.confrelid AND a.attnum=k.num ORDER BY k.n) AS referenced_columns,
CASE WHEN c.contype='f' THEN c.confdeltype END AS delete_action,CASE WHEN c.contype='f' THEN c.confupdtype END AS update_action
FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.connamespace JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid=c.conrelid LEFT JOIN pg_class rt ON rt.oid=c.confrelid LEFT JOIN pg_namespace rn ON rn.oid=rt.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.contype IN ('p','u','f','c','x') ORDER BY t.relname,c.contype,c.conname
